sloka: ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः ।वादित्राणां च निनदः पूरयन्निव सागरम् ।शुश्रुवे शङ्खशब्दश्च प्रयाते वाहिनीपतौ ।। ६.५७.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: tato dundubhinirghoṣaḥ parjanyaninadopamaḥ ।vāditrāṇāṁ ca ninadaḥ pūrayanniva sāgaram ।śuśruve śaṅkhaśabdaśca prayāte vāhinīpatau ।। 6.57.29 ।।।।

translations.english: As the CommanderinChief was going there arose sounds of kettle drums, blasts of fanfares, and noise of blasts of conchs filling the earth was heard.
